verified.note: Sec. IV A, text, E_tot^BE2 (arXiv line 240); version read: the journal's full text (pubs.aip.org, 2026-11-25), same value, and the arXiv text (sources/2603.11463.txt) | Eqs. (1)-(4), arXiv lines 62-91: H = -t sum (c+c + h.c.) + U sum n_up n_dn + ω0 sum b+b + g sum (b+_i + b_i)(n_i,up + n_i,dn), coupling to n_i, no zero-point term; t = 1, ω0 = 0.25 for every calculation (line 166); the 8-site half-filled chain (N_e = 8) at U = 8, g = 0.5 (lines 236-238); total energies. Boundary: open. The text leaves out 'the first and last fragments to avoid edge overcounting' (lines 229-230, same in the journal), so the chain has ends; the authors' code that the data-availability statement cites (ref. 50, github.com/Shariful38/fb-BE, commit 20fad1e) builds the hopping with range(n_sites - 1) and no closing bond, in the fb-BE and the DMRG scripts (2026-11-25). The phonons are a product of coherent states (mean field) and the text calls the embedding non-variational (line 349). No conversion.
